analysis_meta.analysis_method: Cross-section loop count tracking + Measurement Cage topology progression

x_axis_sections.description: Vertical slices perpendicular to X axis (constant X, varying Y-Z)

progression.interpretation: At extremity; single small loop (likely top of head region or edge artifact)
Two distinct loops: primary oval body profile + base platform circle
progression.notes: Opening may not yet be visible at this X-station; loops still closed

progression.interpretation: Significant complexity increase: main profile + base + 3 additional internal structures
progression.notes: Internal loops (L02, L03, L04) may indicate: opening edge topology, surface singularities, or measurement artifact. REQUIRES VALIDATION.

y_axis_sections.description: Lateral slices perpendicular to Y axis (constant Y, varying X-Z)
y_axis_sections.status: Present in data but detailed structure not extracted in this analysis
y_axis_sections.interpretation: Expected to show front-back asymmetry (front_depth ≠ rear_depth per design)

z_axis_sections.description: Horizontal slices perpendicular to Z axis (constant Z, varying X-Y)
z_axis_sections.expected_progression: Based on asymmetric_superellipse design with 10 z-stations (S00-S09)
z_axis_sections.s00_z_40: Small base profile (~1050mm width+depth in design units)

topology_events.description: Maximum diameter zone; width and depth grow
Front opening changes loop topology; may introduce secondary loops or loop splits

events.description: Single apex profile becomes two-loop topology (body + base rim)
Two loops expand to five loops (main + rim + 3 internal structures)
events.notes: Interpretation unclear; may indicate opening edge structure or measurement artifact

events.description: Front opening introduces asymmetry and possible loop fragmentation
events.topology_impact: Converts otherwise closed loop into open edge structure

events.description: Profiles shrink as shape tapers towards apex
Final profile converges to topological point (apex singularity)

consequence_1_opening_boundary.rule: NO PATCH shall cross HARD_TOPOLOGY_BOUNDARY (front opening)
consequence_1_opening_boundary.impact: Minimum 2 patches required to handle opening: one covering opening loop edge, another for main body surface

consequence_2_base_separation.rule: Base rim topology (bottom L00-type loops) should be segmented from main body
consequence_2_base_separation.impact: At least 1 separate patch for base/foot region

consequence_3_apex_singularity.rule: POLE (apex point at Z_max) requires special handling
options: Single patch covering entire upper section (handles pole naturally if using NURBS Loft with apex)
Multiple patches with T-junction vertices at pole (more complex, requires extraordinary vertex handling)

consequence_4_internal_loop_complexity.rule: Internal loops (X02_L02, L03, L04) must be interpreted before patch generation
options: Real internal features → separate patch topology
Measurement Cage artifacts → ignore for patch generation
Opening edge topology → incorporated into opening patch

surface_flow_topology.consequence: Cannot use simple cylindrical (theta, z) parametrization; must use custom surface flow
surface_flow_topology.asymmetry_handling: YZ-plane symmetry suggests left-right mirror; apply to final patch layout

critical_topology_constraints: DO NOT force exact symmetry; use APPROXIMATE mirror with tolerance
DO manage POLE singularity at Z_apex (EV_006)
DO clarify role of INTERNAL_LOOPS (EV_003) before patch generation
